newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA - April 24.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA - April 24.

text.p: Live Sales - Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not tested, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
